newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's president hosts radio chat show.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's president hosts radio chat show.

text.p: Ecuador's singing President Abdala Bucaram will stretch his career further on Friday night with his debut as host of a radio talk show.

"A Chat from the Chimney" will be broadcast by state radio every Friday and the president will talk about his week in an "honest and personal conversation with the people of Ecuador," a government advertisement said.

Bucaram has dazzled Ecuador since taking office more than five months ago by recording a music CD called "Madman in Love," singing at concerts, flying combat planes, dining with Lorena Bobbit, shaving his moustache for charity and playing soccer matches.
On Tuesday, Bucaram became chairman of the popular local soccer club Barcelona, realising a life-long ambition that he said was as big as becoming president of Ecuador.
